title: Chicken and Stew Velvety Pasta
description: A rich and creamy Italian pasta dish featuring chicken and stew in a velvety sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and cook until softened.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the stew and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add the velvety and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the velvety sauce.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
